_doc: THE ONE committed source of deploy truth for Mintware. A deploy is NOT done until it is recorded here. No entry = NOT deployed (do not infer deployment from prose in a rule/doc/memory). Read by scripts/context-sync.mjs to generate the AUTO:build-status block in .claude/STATE.md. Fields per contract: address (checksummed; null if the full address isn't yet recorded), chainId, status (live|testnet|deprecated), note, verified (ISO date the address was last confirmed on-chain).
_reconcile: When you deploy (or deprecate) a contract, update this file IN THE SAME PR (CONTEXT-MAP reconcile-on-change). Prefer copying the address straight from the Foundry broadcast record. If you only have a truncated address, set address:null and put the partial in note — an explicit gap beats a fake-precise ghost.

AIAttribution.note: v3 — the ONLY mainnet contract. v2 (0xb9FB965...) deprecated.
